credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Mimosa pudica, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mimosa_pudica . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Mimosa pudica. BRACED: a small pink shoot planted in a low mound, curving toward the foe; feathery bipinnate leaves (a fan of pinnae combed with rows of tiny leaflets) with the big lead leaf raised like a shield, a closed pink bud on top, and one low leaf caught folding shut, its petiole drooping. Gesture: the leaflets fold shut in a wave running from the lead leaf to the rear, each leaf reopening as it passes; the shoot, mound and bud stay fixed. Fresh leaf green in the dark slot (leaflets, rachises), pom-pom pink as the mid tone (stems, petioles, buds, flower heads). Sport: a white pom-pom form, an artistic interpretation (no white form is described in the reference).
